compilerOptionComments.typeRoots: After adding typeRoots, in order to avoid an error for "Cannot find type definition file for '@testing-library/jest-dom'", we need to add node_modules/@testing-library to the typeRoots. See https://github.com/testing-library/jest-dom/issues/559#issuecomment-1857877035 and https://stackoverflow.com/a/77669315/309011
compilerOptionComments.useUnknownInCatchVariables: We've never gotten an error in our other projects from a non-Error thrown, so the extra type safety provided by treating catch (err) as unknown is probably not needed
